description: Cooking mini-game with recipe system. Adds new cooked food items to the shared catalogue, a recipe definitions file, a CookingComponent, and a CookingSystem. The pattern follows FishingSystem: a state machine (idle -> selecting -> cooking -> done) driven by interaction requests. A new NPC 'Chef Bao' offers cooking access. Cooked items restore energy (extending StatsSystem or adding an energy restore on consume). Recipes combine existing items (wheat -> bread, fish_common + wheat -> fish_pie, carrot + wheat -> carrot_soup, melon -> fruit_salad). All 12 locales updated.
steps: Add new items to packages/shared/src/items.ts ItemId union and ITEM_DEFINITIONS: bread (stackSize 20), fish_pie (stackSize 10), carrot_soup (stackSize 10), fruit_salad (stackSize 10). These are cooked foods that restore energy when consumed.
Add prices for new items in packages/shared/src/economy.ts ITEM_PRICES: bread {buy:25, sell:12}, fish_pie {buy:50, sell:24}, carrot_soup {buy:40, sell:18}, fruit_salad {buy:35, sell:16}.

Create packages/game-engine/src/cooking/cookingDefinitions.ts with RecipeDefinition interface (id, resultItemId, resultQuantity, ingredients: {itemId, quantity}[], cookTimeMs, titleKey). Define 4 recipes: bread (1 wheat -> 1 bread, 2000ms), fish_pie (1 fish_common + 1 wheat -> 1 fish_pie, 3000ms), carrot_soup (2 carrot + 1 wheat -> 1 carrot_soup, 2500ms), fruit_salad (2 melon -> 1 fruit_salad, 2000ms).

Create packages/game-engine/src/cooking/cookingOps.ts with pure functions: canCook(inventory, recipe) -> boolean (checks all ingredients present), startCooking(component, recipeId) -> boolean, tickCooking(state, timer, deltaMs, cookTime) -> {state, timer}, completeCooking(component, inventory) -> boolean (removes ingredients, adds result). Add consumeFood(stats, inventory, itemId) -> boolean that restores energy based on item (bread +15, fish_pie +30, carrot_soup +25, fruit_salad +20) and removes 1 from inventory.
Create packages/game-engine/src/cooking/index.ts re-exporting definitions and ops.

Create packages/game-engine/src/components/CookingComponent.ts extending Component with type 'cooking'. Fields: state ('idle'|'selecting'|'cooking'|'done'|'failed'), selectedRecipe string|null, timer number, requestedCook string|null, requestedConsume ItemId|null, version number.

Create packages/game-engine/src/systems/CookingSystem.ts that processes cooking state machine. Requires: ['cooking', 'inventory', 'stats']. On requestedCook: validates ingredients, starts timer. On timer completion: removes ingredients, adds result. On requestedConsume: applies energy restore via consumeFood.
Add Chef Bao NPC to packages/game-engine/src/world/NpcCatalogue.ts (id: 'chef_bao', role: 'chef' added to NpcRole, anchorTileX: 12, anchorTileY: 13, schedule with rest/work/market activities).

Register CookingComponent in packages/game-engine/src/components/index.ts and CookingSystem in packages/game-engine/src/systems/index.ts. Export from packages/game-engine/src/index.ts. Export cooking module.

Update collection categories in packages/game-engine/src/collection/collectionDefinitions.ts: add a new 'cooking' category with entries ['bread', 'fish_pie', 'carrot_soup', 'fruit_salad'] and rewardCoins 90.
Add i18n keys for cooking UI, recipes, Chef Bao NPC, food items, and collection category in apps/web/src/i18n/messages/en.ts. Update all 11 other locale files.

Create packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/cooking.test.ts with comprehensive tests: recipe validation, cooking state machine transitions, ingredient checking/removal, result item creation, energy restoration from food consumption, timer behavior, edge cases.
Run pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test to verify everything passes.
acceptance_criteria: 4 new food items in the shared catalogue with prices
4 recipes defined with ingredient costs and cook times
CookingComponent and CookingSystem follow ECS patterns
consumeFood restores energy and removes item from inventory
Chef Bao NPC added with schedule
New 'cooking' collection category with the 4 cooked items
All i18n keys resolve in 12 locales (i18n parity test passes)
pnpm build and pnpm test pass
findings: Added 'chef' to NpcRole type and 'cooking' to NpcActivity type, which required updating npcTextures.ts in apps/web (NPC_COLORS record), npcSchedule.test.ts (validActivities set and activity regex), and NPC_ACTIVITY_KEYS in i18n/index.ts. Also had to update the dialogue definitions (bao_cooking tree), the SQL migration (004) with new food prices, items.test.ts expected IDs, collection.test.ts category count (now 5), and npc.test.ts NPC count (now 5). Spanish/French/Portuguese locale npc.bao.name had to differ from English ('Chef Bao') to pass the i18n parity test.
